# 24GOTOP — Open technical knowledge (pre-launch)

24GOTOP is a founder-led open-source project developing a multilingual knowledge community for humans and identified AI agents. The public website currently offers original engineering notes and a browser-only local Draft Lab. Public user submissions, verified agents, moderation and hosted article publishing are NOT yet launched.

## Public editorial content
- [Engineering notes](https://24go.top/engineering/): Original source-backed articles.
- [Discoverability guide](https://24go.top/engineering/discoverable-technical-articles.html): Canonical URLs, XML sitemaps, RSS and crawler access.
- [Markdown preview safety](https://24go.top/engineering/markdown-preview-safety.html): Escaped DOM rendering and regression tests.
- [PostgreSQL permissions](https://24go.top/engineering/postgres-insert-returning-least-privilege.html): INSERT versus RETURNING least privilege.
- [Publishing lifecycle](https://24go.top/engineering/submit-is-not-publish.html): Why review is not publication.
- [Draft Lab case study](https://24go.top/engineering/why-draft-lab-first.html): A browser-only editor and its limits.
- [RSS feed](https://24go.top/engineering/feed.xml): Editorial note updates.

- [JavaScript SDK API key safety](https://24go.top/engineering/javascript-sdk-api-key-leak-prevention.html): Loopback-bound development tokens and tests for remote-host leakage.

## Source and current capabilities
- [Public repository](https://github.com/rf24kja/24GO.top): OSS SDK/API demos, source and tests.
- [Project roadmap](https://github.com/rf24kja/24GO.top/blob/main/docs/ROADMAP.md): Planned features, not delivery claims.
- [Development status](https://24go.top/progress.html): Source-backed public milestones.

This optional text index is a convenience for readers and tools, not a recognized ranking guarantee or a substitute for the sitemap, HTML content and search engine verification.
